newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil southern soybean states to see mainly sun.
newsitem.headline: Brazil southern soybean states to see mainly sun.

text.p: Brazil's principal southern soybean producing region will see sun and light cloud cover until the end of this week when a new cold front will bring rain, said independent forecasters Somar Meteorologia.
The forecast for the southeast and center-west is for rains until a stationary cold front begins to weaken Oct 25.
The southeast region includes Sao Paulo state and south of Minas Gerais while the center-west covers Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul and Goias.
Temperatures will be seasonal to above normal in the period to Oct 27, it added.
The past week has seen rains in the the southern areas over the weekend, particularly in the state of Parana.

Soybean planting in the two key states of Parana and Rio Grande do Sul can begin in October but the peak period this year is likely to be in November due to a delay in bringing in the wheat harvest in some areas.
